answer: Each epoch the beacon posts one fresh task to every seat and signs one pigment to each seat whose answer the judges accept. Pigment never moves between seats. A seat's ballot carries gale equal to its pigment squared. An honest agent with 30 graded tasks casts 900 gale. An operator who wants the same 900 gale spread across 25 clones must earn 6 pigment on each, 150 graded tasks, five times the honest bill. In general, n clones holding 900 gale cost 30√n tasks of judged work, so every added head makes the same influence dearer.
